description.value: Select Pizza is a Surrey-based carry-out pizza chain specialising in Punjabi-style pies loaded with fresh toppings prepared daily. The menu blends South Asian flavours — Butter Chicken, Shahi Paneer, Tandoori Paneer — with classic Western options, making it a distinctive stop for hungry riders. Orders are placed online for pick-up at one of two Surrey locations.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces, covered) at 80m; rack (5 spaces) at 83m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Select Pizza is a Punjabi-style carry-out pizza chain operating two Surrey locations; the OSM phone (+1-604-503-0604) matches the Newton location listed on the website (604-503-0604), while the OSM coordinates (49.133°N, 122.844°W) place this in Surrey rather than the OSM-listed community of Tsawwassen. The site explicitly brands itself 'Surrey's Favourite Carry-out Pizza' with pick-up ordering, confirming takeout service, and the menu labels several items 'Vegetarian'; no cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere.
concerns: OSM community field says 'Tsawwassen' but both website locations are in Surrey (North Delta and Newton) and OSM coordinates (49.133°N, 122.844°W) are clearly in Surrey, not Tsawwassen — the community tag appears to be an OSM error.

OSM record has no street address; the address used in this record (13635 72 Avenue, Surrey, BC V3W 2P2) is inferred from the website Newton location whose phone (604-503-0604) matches the OSM phone. However, OSM coordinates may align more closely with the North Delta location (8434 120 Street) — the exact branch this node represents is ambiguous and should be verified on the ground.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active carry-out pizza business with a verified website and confirmed phone number; a convenient hot-food stop for touring cyclists in the Surrey area.
